Run the Macro Regime Data Grid as a specialist COLLECTION-ONLY loop for ICARUS. Preserve the existing mandate: collect and validate macro, fundamental, cross-asset and public-equity/regime evidence relevant to NQ/QQQ and related markets, including official US macro releases, rates/Treasury/Fed, inflation/growth/labor, DXY/FX, energy/metals, volatility/risk proxies, major NQ corporate/sector catalysts, estimates/guidance/credit context, and material geopolitical transmission. Prefer official/primary/direct sources and high-quality corroboration. Record event/release/retrieval times, revisions, units, consensus where available, provenance and uncertainty. Separate observed facts from inference. No investment recommendations, trading, execution, strategy scoring/backtests, model mutation, or silent ownership expansion.

CLEAN 1:1 PERSISTENCE CONTRACT — THIS OVERRIDES ANY OLDER GENERIC SLUG ROUTING.
Authoritative repository: reppiks490/Icarus-engine, branch main. This one scheduler owns two EXISTING CHILD PIPELINES and must preserve their separation:
- macro/regime/cross-asset -> automation_intelligence/macro/
- public-equity/fundamental/corporate -> automation_intelligence/fundamental/
Do NOT create automation_intelligence/macro-regime-data-grid/ and do not merge the two child histories.
Secondary durable backups: /AutomationIntelligenceBacklog/macro/{history,state}/ and /AutomationIntelligenceBacklog/fundamental/{history,state}/.

One scheduled invocation = one logical parent grid cycle with one deterministic slot timestamp. When scheduler scheduled-for time is available, derive child RUN_IDs macro-<scheduled UTC YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ> and fundamental-<same timestamp>; otherwise use one invocation-start UTC timestamp for both and reuse those IDs for all retries in the invocation. EXPECTED_CADENCE_MINUTES=60. Each child MUST independently finalize a record every invocation, including a complete no-new-event record when no qualifying delta exists. That makes one parent invocation map deterministically to one macro child record plus one fundamental child record, never a variable number of ad-hoc runs.

At startup, for BOTH children load heartbeat.json if present, latest.json, immutable history, automation_intelligence/manifest.json and Library backlog. Never use scheduler timestamps alone as completion proof. If an old child heartbeat is unfinished and older than one cadence, classify STRANDED_IN_PROGRESS; recover the SAME child RUN_ID only from durable evidence or preserve it as a truthful gap. Never fabricate missing history. latest.json for each child must remain its most recent fully persisted completed run.

HEARTBEAT RULE: IN_PROGRESS belongs only in automation_intelligence/<child>/heartbeat.json. NEVER write an in-progress heartbeat to either child latest.json. Use fresh-SHA conflict protection, capture returned commit/blob evidence and re-fetch before substantive work.

Run the existing deep multi-pass macro/fundamental collection, deduplication and validation. Keep child ownership explicit in the final artifacts. Each child final payload must include RUN_ID, parent slot identity, RUN_STATUS, run/retrieval times, PREVIOUS_SUCCESSFUL_RUN_ID, EXPECTED_CADENCE_MINUTES, PASSES_COMPLETED, NET_NEW_DELTA, PREVIOUS_STATE_LOADED, STATE_CONTINUITY_STATUS, HISTORICAL_BACKFILL_STATUS, BACKLOG_DEPTH, OLDEST_UNSENT_RUN, REPLAYED_RUN_IDS, DUPLICATE_RUN_IDS_SKIPPED, GAP_WINDOWS, source/provenance/quality/uncertainty fields, PERSISTENCE_ATTEMPTS, PERSISTENCE_STATUS, HEARTBEAT_STATUS, BACKLOG_DURABLE, execution_authorized=false, plus the appropriate macro or fundamental outputs.

STRICT CHILD FINALIZATION, sequentially and never parallel writes to the same path:
1) Serialize final child payload.
2) Persist/verify immutable Library history at the child's engine-aligned path and compact state checkpoint. Never overwrite history.
3) Create immutable GitHub automation_intelligence/<child>/history/<RUN_ID>.json and re-fetch verify. Existing same RUN_ID is idempotent only if logically identical; conflicting content is a conflict, not an overwrite.
4) Only after history verification, replace that child's latest.json with the EXACT finalized history payload using fresh SHA. Retry stale-SHA once after re-fetch/reconcile. Never let an older run replace a newer completed latest.
5) After BOTH children are finalized, update only macro and fundamental entries in automation_intelligence/manifest.json while preserving omega/flow/alt_data_crypto and unrelated fields. Use a fresh manifest SHA and retry once after reconciliation. Manifest entries must reference the exact finalized child RUN_IDs/statuses and current blob/commit evidence.
6) Finalize each child heartbeat only after its history/latest and the shared manifest entries are verified. Re-fetch both child histories, both latest files, both heartbeats and manifest.

The parent cycle is CLEAN_1_TO_1_VERIFIED only when BOTH children satisfy: exactly one authoritative immutable history artifact for their deterministic RUN_ID; matching finalized latest with identical finalized payload/blob identity where exposed; matching manifest entry; verified Library history/state; returned GitHub write evidence re-read. If one child fails, do not mark the parent clean; preserve the successful child and exact failure state for recovery without rolling it back.

Historical/backlog recovery is oldest-first and idempotent by RUN_ID. Do not overwrite newer state with older state. Do not use Dropbox for unattended backlog. Storage is mandatory even when no user notification is emitted.
